body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If you targeted the same creature with another Prowess Action this turn, ignore 1 Defense.

surges.html: Deal +1 weapon damage. If the target is already wounded, this costs 1 fewer Surge, minimum 1.
Deal +1 weapon damage; you suffer -1 Defense until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: BLITZ
rider.html: After this Action deals damage, you may spend 1 Combo to gain +1 die on your next Prowess Action this turn.
